name: Beheading
overview: Scripture records beheading as a form of execution used against key figures such as John the Baptist and James the brother of John, highlighting the cost of faithful witness to God’s truth. In Matthew 14:10 and Mark 6:27, John is beheaded by royal command, while Acts 12:2 notes James was killed with the sword. Revelation 20:4 further reveals that those beheaded for their testimony of Jesus and refusal to worship the beast are honored in Christ’s kingdom, affirming the eternal reward for martyrdom borne out of steadfast faith.
